decisions.decision: Move Team pricing to $59 for new customers starting 2026-09-01, and grandfather existing Team customers for 4 months.

source.speaker: Nina Patel
source.quote: Proposal: move the Team plan from $49 to $59 next month. Expansion revenue is strong, but onboarding time per Team account is higher than we modeled.

reasoning.claim: Onboarding time per Team account is higher than modeled.

source.speaker: Nina Patel

reasoning.claim: Team gross margin is below target once implementation support is included.

source.speaker: Marco Silva
source.quote: I support the increase. At $49, Team gross margin is below target once implementation support is included. The tradeoff is we may lose some very small teams.

objections.claim: Current Team customers could be surprised.

source.speaker: Aisha Rahman
source.quote: I'm worried about surprising current Team customers. Assuming we grandfather existing Team customers for 4 months, CS can handle the messaging.
